title: Development of Citizen Grievance Portal and Mobile Application

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Design and develop a bilingual (English/Urdu) citizen grievance web portal. Build Android and iOS mobile apps with complaint tracking and SMS notifications. Host the solution on cloud infrastructure and provide 12 months of support.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: The bidder must be a company registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP).
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must be a company registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 30 million during the last three financial years.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 30 million during the last three financial years.

eligibility.requirement: The bidder must have been in business for at least 3 years.
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must have been in business for at least 3 years.

eligibility.requirement: Two similar web/mobile projects of PKR 5M+
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must have completed at least two similar web or mobile application projects, each worth PKR 5 million or more, for public or private clients.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
